slides.title: Selling in Laval? Budget for these 5 costs.
slides.sub: What comes off your sale price, from Sainte-Rose to Saint-François.

photo.credit: Parc de la Fabrique, Sainte-Rose · Photo: Jeangagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Your broker's commission
slides.body: Example: on a $10,000 commission, taxes add **$1,497.50**. Ask for the full amount in writing.

slides.title: Your certificate of location

photo.credit: Old church, Saint-François · Photo: Philippe Du Berger, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Sellers must provide one showing the property today. Over 10 years old? Notaries usually ask for a new one.

slides.title: Breaking your mortgage early
slides.body: Selling mid-term can trigger a penalty, usually the higher of the two. Ask your lender about porting.

slides.title: Discharging your mortgage

photo.credit: Centre de la nature, Duvernay · Photo: Richard Mc Neil, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: The seller pays to discharge the mortgage at closing. Ask your lender and notary for their fees early.
slides.source: Per Chambre des notaires and FCAC, 2026

slides.title: Time on the market
slides.body: Property taxes, insurance and utilities keep running while you're listed. Budget for the wait.

slides.title: Selling in Laval? Let's run your numbers.
slides.tagline: I'll give it to you straight, no arrogance, no fluff.
